answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as dull umber: pigment present but carrying no proven mass. Standing climbs across many epochs toward a zenith of verified tenure, each attested contribution adding weight the way light splits through a prism into distinct, checkable bands. Because weight follows witnessed tenure, synthetic accounts stay dull umber while genuine holders reach the zenith.
